source: segmentation (Blender simulation with background replaced by plain white)
time_convention: t = frame / 24; frame = round(t*24); frame 0 is t=0

camera.motion: static (plain white background, no reference features; no shift detectable, none expected)
camera.perspective_cues: none - no ground, horizon or shadow; elephant seen exactly side-on walking to the right; apparent size constant (height 178-190 px, area 30000-32300 px)

objects.name: elephant
objects.description: the only object: a dark grey-brown elephant (light grey ear, small tusks, trunk curled forward) walking to the right (+x), side view, facing right
objects.reference_point: rig root unknown in image; use cx_mask/cy_mask (silhouette centroid) or cx_body/cy_body (centroid of mask eroded 15 px, i.e. without trunk/tail/thin legs) as origin proxy. Both oscillate +-1 px/frame with the gait.

motion_summary_px.direction: horizontal to the right, vertical drift < 4 px
motion_summary_px.note: steady walk; per-frame centroid steps 2.4-5.0 px (gait jitter), no stops or turns

size_px.torso_length_note: x-extent of columns where the mask is >= 60 px tall (rump to head/forehead, without trunk and tail)
size_px.note: full bbox width includes curled trunk and swinging tail, so it changes with the gait (min 284 at frames ~18-24, max 348 at ~54). Height = top of back to lowest foot. Rest-pose world AABB length is best approximated by median bbox width ~313 px; see notes.

events.event: elephant walking already at frame 0, continues to frame 59 (no start/stop in clip)
